# Tacking

Tacking turns the bow of the boat through the wind to change from one close-hauled course to the other. The jib crosses the foredeck and the mainsail swings over with the boom. Tack on a header, as in [[Reading the wind]].

## Helm and crew

Call "ready about", push the tiller to leeward, release the old jib sheet as the jib backs, and trim the new sheet in on the other side.

## Missing stays

A tack fails when the boat stalls head to wind. Bear away to build speed first and steer through the turn smoothly.
